briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion launch intensifies US-China AGI race with safety gaps exposed

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record compute investments while regulatory scrutiny mounts. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate production incidents, pushing protocol-level innovations forward.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-5 performance at lower cost; Meta open-sources Llama 4.1.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce joint 50GW data center expansion in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
